name: Kashmir
note: Can mean the whole former state, including Ladakh

name: Punjab
note: Before 1966 Punjab included Haryana and parts of Himachal Pradesh; before 1947, Pakistani Punjab

name: Uttarakhand
note: Before 2000 part of Uttar Pradesh: older records may say Uttar Pradesh

name: NEFA
note: North-East Frontier Agency, now Arunachal Pradesh

name: Assam
note: Before 1972 included Meghalaya, and before 1987 Mizoram

name: Mysore State
note: Old name of Karnataka. Mysore alone is also a city: left unplaced.

name: Travancore Cochin
note: State from 1949 to 1956; its southern tip is now in Tamil Nadu

name: Madras State
note: Old name of Tamil Nadu, until 1969. Madras alone is a city: left unplaced.

name: Ladakh
note: Before 2019 part of Jammu and Kashmir
